values.quote: System plus system (2N / 2(N+1)) | 99.99997% | Tier IV | $36,000 - $42,000
values.note: Distributed redundant Tier III $24,000-30,000; isolated redundant Tier II $18,000-24,000.

values.label: Cost multiplier of 2N vs N design (derived from WP75 midpoints)
values.source_title: Comparing UPS System Design Configurations (White Paper 75, Rev 4)
values.quote: System plus system (2N / 2(N+1)) | 99.99997% | Tier IV | $36,000 - $42,000
values.note: Derived: $39,000 / $15,750 = 2.48; Tier III (distributed redundant) / N = $27,000 / $15,750 = 1.71.

values.label: UPS cost effect of 2N vs 1N architecture (Schneider WP108)
values.source_title: Making Large UPS Systems More Efficient (White Paper 108, Rev 3)
values.quote: costs ... nearly double when the same UPSs are analyzed as a redundant 2N architecture
values.note: UPS equipment and energy costs only.

values.label: Modelled availability, N (capacity) UPS configuration
values.source_title: Comparing UPS System Design Configurations (White Paper 75, Rev 4)
values.quote: Capacity (N) | 99.92%
values.note: 2N / 2(N+1): 99.99997%; distributed redundant with STS 99.9994%. Paper says values are comparison tools, not predictors.

values.label: Generator sizing buffer above calculated facility load
values.source_title: The Complete Guide to Generator Sizing & Redundancy for Tier III & Tier IV Data Centers
values.quote: Always size your generator system with at least a 20-25% buffer above your calculated load.
values.note: Method: IT load x PUE then add buffer; e.g. 1,000 kW IT x 1.4 = 1,400 kW, buffer to ~1,750 kW. Derate ~3% per 1,000 ft altitude.

values.label: Generator capacity per MW of IT load (derived from sizing rule)
values.source_title: The Complete Guide to Generator Sizing & Redundancy for Tier III & Tier IV Data Centers
values.quote: a generator (or generator system) capable of supplying at least 1,400kW of continuous power
values.note: Derived: 1,000 kW x PUE 1.4 x 1.25 = 1,750 kW; N+1 adds one unit, 2N doubles the plant.

values.label: Pad-mounted transformer lead time (C&W 2026 guide)
values.source_title: Data Center Construction Costs Jump 21% Since 2024 (reporting Cushman & Wakefield 2026 Data Center Development Cost Guide)
values.quote: Pad-mounted transformers: 68 to 113 weeks
values.note: Central = midpoint.

values.label: Generator lead time (C&W 2026 guide)
values.source_title: Data Center Construction Costs Jump 21% Since 2024 (reporting Cushman & Wakefield 2026 Data Center Development Cost Guide)
values.quote: Generators: 60 to 100 weeks
values.note: Central = midpoint.

values.label: Medium-voltage switchgear lead time (C&W 2026 guide)
values.source_title: Data Center Construction Costs Jump 21% Since 2024 (reporting Cushman & Wakefield 2026 Data Center Development Cost Guide)
values.quote: Medium-voltage switchgear: 38 to 63 weeks
values.note: Central = midpoint; Giga Energy (Wood Mackenzie) cites switchgear average 44 weeks, DC-spec MV switchgear 2-3 years.

values.label: Power transformer lead time (Wood Mackenzie survey via Giga Energy)
values.source_title: The constraints that cause lead time delays for data centers
values.quote: Power transformers averaged 128 weeks in the same Wood Mackenzie survey.
values.note: Generator step-up units 144 weeks; distribution transformers ~30 weeks blended.

values.label: Industry experts saying local supply chains are not equipped for high-density liquid-cooled AI builds
values.source_title: AI data center rush raises alarm over construction supply chain (Data Center Construction Cost Index 2025-2026)
values.quote: 83 percent of respondents believe local supply chains are not well prepared
values.note: T&T survey of 280 experts; 48% say power availability is the biggest obstacle to schedule.

values.label: Share of impactful outages caused by power
values.source_title: Uptime Institute Global Data Center Survey 2025 (Keynote Report 180)
values.quote: Power remains the top cause of impactful outages, accounting for 45% of incidents in 2025.
values.note: Down from 54% in 2024; 1 in 10 outages serious or severe.
